# mistershell_file_store (Resource)

Manages a MisterShell file store.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mistershell_location" "site" {
  name      = "File storage site"
  kind      = "geo"
  parent_id = 1
}

resource "mistershell_file_store" "example" {
  name        = "site-files"
  backend     = "local"
  location_id = mistershell_location.site.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `backend` (String) Backend.
- `location_id` (Number) Location id.
- `name` (String) Name.

### Optional

- `credential_id` (Number) Credential id.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `params` (Dynamic) Params. Accepts a native Terraform value.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Created at.
- `id` (String) Object identity. Import using this ID; resource variables use resource_id:stack_id.
- `is_builtin` (Boolean) Is builtin.
- `updated_at` (String) Updated at.

## Ownership and lifecycle

This resource manages custom file stores. Built-in file stores are available through the data source and cannot be imported as managed resources, because the API restricts their updates or deletion.

## Import

```shell
terraform import mistershell_file_store.example 123
```
